list.name: device_id
list.query:
SELECT DISTINCT device_id
FROM telemetry_metrics
WHERE metric_type = 'latency_avg_ms'
ORDER BY device_id

targets.rawSql:
SELECT timestamp AS time, metric_value AS "avg", device_id AS device
FROM telemetry_metrics
WHERE metric_type = 'latency_avg_ms'
  AND device_id IN (${device_id:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY time

SELECT timestamp AS time, metric_value AS "min", device_id AS device
FROM telemetry_metrics
WHERE metric_type = 'latency_min_ms'
  AND device_id IN (${device_id:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY time

SELECT timestamp AS time, metric_value AS "max", device_id AS device
FROM telemetry_metrics
WHERE metric_type = 'latency_max_ms'
  AND device_id IN (${device_id:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY time

SELECT timestamp AS time, metric_value AS "loss %", device_id AS device
FROM telemetry_metrics
WHERE metric_type = 'packet_loss_percent'
  AND device_id IN (${device_id:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Devices With Highest Latency (last 15 min, avg)

targets.rawSql: SELECT device_id AS metric, AVG(metric_value) AS value FROM telemetry_metrics WHERE metric_type = 'latency_avg_ms' AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY device_id ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10
